biography:
Co-founded T5 Data Centers in March of 2008 to develop, own and operate wholesale data centers and powered data center shells across the country.  T5 owns and operates data centers in 7 key markets providing wholesale data center space, while T5 Enterprise Services provides collocation solutions and services for smaller requirements.  T5 also acquires fully and partially leased data centers, providing owners a means monetize their assets.  T5FM provides facilities management services to third party owners and T5 Construction Services oversees tenant build outs.

Specialties: Wholesale Data Center Owner/Operator, Data Center Acquisitions and Leasebacks, Data Center Development,  Data Center Facilities Management, Construction and Project Management.
